title: This AI App Turns Any Photo Into a Looping 360 Video
description:
This AI tool turns any product photo into a looping 360 video with just one click, using Cense 2.5 and other AI models to generate a full spin from a single image. It runs as a desktop app on both Mac and PC, which means it works faster and keeps your files stored locally instead of uploading everything to the cloud.

For anyone selling products online, this is a fast way to create 3D-style ads without setting up a photo shoot or filming a turntable video. One photo is enough to get a professional-looking result you can drop straight into an ad or listing.
